description: The ready WakeHuBERT streaming 'wake up' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.12).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic only: an edge-tts voice grid, OmniVoice no-reference clips, with one voice in ten held out; mixed into 30 s synthetic streams (LibriSpeech train-clean-100, KWS windows, AudioSet noise, RIR); streamed WakeHuBERT-tiny int8 features.
